# Phase Completion Record — Template

**Phase:** AR-XX — ...  
**Date / contributor:** ...  
**Status:** Proposed / In progress / Implemented / Tested / Activated / Blocked

## Scope

What changed, why it was needed, and what was explicitly out of scope.

## Files changed

List exact paths and migration identifiers. Link the PR/commit when available.

## Data/ERD/API impacts

Describe new tables, columns, fields, endpoints, contracts and backwards compatibility. State **none** when applicable.

## Authorization and security

Actor/permission model, object scope, audit events, failure behavior, race prevention, revocation, secrets and recovery.

## Verification evidence

Commands run, settings/database used, test counts, failure logs (redacted), browser/manual validation, and source review. Separate **tests passed** from **feature activated**.

## Deployment / rollback

Configuration changes, backups, database migrations, enablement decision, rollback conditions and monitoring.

## Documents updated

- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md`
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `docs/testing/TEST_RESULTS.md`
- [ ] Security / ADR docs (if relevant)
- [ ] SRS / ERD / architecture / API docs (if affected)

## Open issues / next phase

What remains blocked, who must approve it, and how readiness will be demonstrated.

## Closure check

- [ ] Reviewed code
- [ ] Passing relevant tests
- [ ] Permissions/governance reviewed
- [ ] Documentation matches code and DB state
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in docs
- [ ] Reviewed commit or PR prepared
